title: Backend REST & GraphQL APIs with Node

lessons.title: Microservice Architecture & Express / Fastify
overview: Architect scalable Node.js microservices with dependency injection, connection pooling, and JWT authentication.
Implement rate limiting, structured JSON logging, and security headers.

takeaways.title: Connection Pooling
takeaways.desc: Manage database connection pools to survive sudden traffic surges without memory exhaustion.

takeaways.title: Stateless Token Auth
takeaways.desc: Use cryptographically signed asymmetric JWTs for cross-service authentication.

lessons.title: API Observability, Docker Deployment & CI/CD
overview: Containerize full-stack applications with multi-stage Docker builds and orchestrate automated GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows.
Monitor production health with distributed tracing and Prometheus metrics.

takeaways.title: Multi-stage Docker Builds
takeaways.desc: Exclude build tooling and development dependencies to yield minimal, secure production container images.

takeaways.title: Zero-Downtime Rollouts
takeaways.desc: Configure health check endpoints and rolling container replacements for continuous deployment.
